services.title: What we do

We bring your brand identity to life, with POP production that creates compelling visual elements to strengthen your identity. Looking to reinvent yourself? With our rebranding services, we revitalize your brand, creating a new visual narrative that stands out in an ever-evolving landscape.

We tear apart barriers between your brand and your audience. From Virtual Reality to Augmented Reality as well as Development, we create interactive experiences that captivate and leave a lifelong experience.
We capture moments and tell stories. From audiovisual production to social media content, we fuse visual and auditory elements to leave a lasting impression.

We make every event unforgettable. From Event Equipment Rentals to Event Production, we take care of every detail to create memorable experiences.

about.title: WHAT WE ARE
articles: For the second consecutive year, the 'Cali Fair' once again vibrated with 'La Fiesta de mi Pueblo', the parade with which the people of Valle del Cauca evoked pride in the department and with which, since its creation, they identified so much themselves as tourists in the traditional 'Calle de la Feria'.

In the second edition of this event, the Government of Valle del Cauca and the Departmental Culture Secretariat, through the mayors and culture secretariats of the 42 municipalities of the department, made an open call for artists and cultural managers to integrate the theoretical-practical workshops on modeling and creative development of the floats that paraded on December 26, 2022 at the Cali Fair.

The call was a success, a total of 200 participants from all the municipalities of Valle del Cauca, including plastic artists, cultural managers, designers, artisans, choreographers, musicians, dancers and the like, accepted the call and were in charge of designing the graphic proposals and artistic performances of the floats and troupes that represented their culture and traditions.

In these workshops, the designs were consolidated and took shape and space in models that finally became the floats that adorned the parade of 'La Fiesta de mi Pueblo, lo que nos' within the framework of the Cali Fair in its 65th version.

In addition to the comparsas and floats of the municipalities, this version of 'La Fiesta de mi Pueblo, lo que Somos' had the presence of national and international artists such as Papo Sánchez, Conjunto Caney, Willy García, Enkanto Orquesta, Anddy Caicedo and the CVC orchestra who paraded along the Calle de la Feria and made the attendees vibrate with their music.

about.title: Concept
articles: Clinicannabis is recognized as the only clinic certified in the management of medical cannabis in the southwest of the country. It has different medical care services to improve the quality of life of patients, through tailored alternatives focused on medical cannabis, advanced physiotherapy, serum therapy, functional medicine and alternative medicine, and an Wellness Experience Center for wellness and education on a healthy lifestyle. In addition, it has a medical expert team to provide humanized care and high quality cannabis-based medicines.

This clinic hosted the Iberoamerican Seminar on Cannabinoids in Clinical Practice in Cali. A great city and academic event that took place on June 16, 2023 in 4 cities total and brought together experts and leaders around medical cannabis in the world; to deliver conceptual and practical tools to health professionals on how to take advantage of the therapeutic effects of this plant.

ingenieria_sas.subtitle: Hacemos Ingeniería considered essential to develop a brand identity which transmitted precisely their activity and high quality level of their projects. This is the resulting branding proposal.

about.title: Concept
articles: In our search of fostering the brand's recognition, we designed a three-dimensional structure with an embedded H, the company's initial. Not only does this shape visually represent the main activity of the company through infrastructure construction and maintenance, but it also eases direct identification of their labor.

Through their "Gestores Ambientales" (Eco-Gestors) program, INCIVA actively fosters the care of Flora and Fauna in the region, Valle del Cauca, Colombia. As part of their pedagogical focus in environmental terms, the campaign "Patrimonio Vital" (Vital Patrimony) sprung during 2020, and it was designed to encourage communities and strengthen high natural impact areas in Valle del Cauca. Having the core goal of cementing INCIVA's brand "Patrimonio Vital", a graphic style that launched as a refresh of its Look and Feel to simplify production and implementation in different formats - especially point of purchase, was developed. These elements where characterized by being made out of sustainable materials, in line with the campaign's commitment to the environment. This strategy, of great relevancy to the Valle del Cauca and the rest of the country, was able to articulate effectively the core message of the initiative.

about.title: Per

It represents the colors, the communication line, the symbols and graphics that are part of the coexistence environment and brand socialization.

articles: In Valle del Cauca we enjoy a unique diversity in flora and fauna, which adorn our landscapes.
Development of a graphic brand proposal for the CVC environmental promoters project.

about.title: Rap del valle
articles: The departmental Secretariat of Culture of Valle del Cauca, Colombia, created the Network of Cultural Monitors, to promote cultural heritage in children and young people. From this effort comes "Rap del Valle Nueva Generación", a music video that highlights the natural, traditional and historical treasures of the region.

The Infinite Evolution Crew, made up of 9 urban artists between 8 and 16 years old, explored 10 municipalities, connecting with iconic places in the Valley. This production was not only an opportunity to create art, but also to discover and connect with the tourist and cultural wealth of the department.

about.title: Juegos nacionales 2023
articles: Valle del Cauca has been recognized for its outstanding career and leadership in the sports field. This is why, for the 2023 National Games, we intended to develop uniforms that would not only identify our athletes, but also represent what is relevant to our region on a national level, including our artists.

For this reason, we were inspired by the characteristic lines and shapes of Omar Rayo, a Valle del Cauca painter renowned both nationally and internationally. We incorporate this identity in the design of the uniforms and in the associated graphic pieces.
